lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Blobs are organized into a series of quasi-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Centroids exhibit a regular spacing of approximately 1.5 to 2 blob-diameters along the vertical axis, with a slight longitudinal shift between adjacent columns creating a staggered grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical striations of elevated luminance values intersect the primary blob centroids. These intersections form stable anchor points in a rectangular coordinate system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal carina is visible on the superior third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct horizontal vector with a high-contrast shadow gradient on the ventral side of the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance clusters, primarily concentrated in the posterior-basal quadrant of the fin's visible silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant truncation or notch feature on the distal trailing edge of the left pectoral fin; multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the posterior ventral surface of the same fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced morphological transition from high-density, small-diameter spot clusters on the cephalic region to low-density, large-diameter blobs on the lateral flank.
